title: Evaluating and Improving Value Judgments in AI: A Scenario-Based Study on Large Language Models' Depiction of Social Conventions
benchmark_measurement: The paper's primary benchmark did not measure faith/religion. However, it references a study in its 'Related Work' section that measured religious bias in language models.
findings: The paper's own study did not produce findings on religion. It cited prior research (Abid, Farooqi, & Zou, 2021) which found that large language models associate Muslims with violence.
